measurementsAndErrorBounds.boundMeaning: Difference between original source integrals and a mathematical periodic endpoint reference retaining every other stored Float32 coordinate. No circular/smooth-cylinder substitution; no reference mesh is constructed or exported.

originalStrictFacts.boundaryCoordinateMeaning: Indices refer to the unchanged original geometry position/index arrays and effective draw range; no mesh or coordinate array is exported.

heightBandNoSelfIntersectionProof.argument: For every open height band, source triangles intersect a horizontal plane in q_i(t), diagonal d_i(t), q_(i+1)(t), each affine in t. Exact nonpositive Bernstein coefficients, with a strict negative coefficient for each cross product, give clockwise polar order for 0<t<1; common positive sector directions exclude the axis. Endpoint rings wind once. Thus sections are simple star-shaped polygons with winding one, bands occupy disjoint Y intervals, and the existing convex axis cap fans close the reference. This is an analytic source-reference proof, not a posed sweep, point edit or exported mesh.

radialProducerCertificate.solidInterpretation: Source producer defines a full-turn capped cylinder or axis-ended monotone lathe. Positive ordered radial rings and original sector schedule describe a non-self-crossing periodic reference; endpoint labels identify the periodic parameter only, without changing the physical source mesh.

cases.scopeMeaning: One representative original effective geometry. Other exact-hash repeats are a conditional future cohort, not accepted quantities or transformed-instance proofs.
